name: City Council Regular Meeting - 6:30 p.m. SUPPLEMENTAL STAFF REPORT
agenda_text:
City Council Staff Report

  DATE: April 5, 2023
  AGENDA ITEM NO: 3G - SUPPLEMENTAL

 TO:  The Honorable Mayor and City Council
 FROM:  Matthew Hallock, Fire Chief
 SUBJECT:  Supplemental Staff Report regarding item 3-G, 2020 State Homeland
  Security Grant Program – Cost Savings

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
As per Resolution No. 11740 adopted by the City Council on May 6, 2015, Section 2.B,
“Acquisitions authorized by this resolution must be completely paid for using grant funds
from SHSGP or UASI only. The use of general fund monies is not authorized by this
resolution unless the call for projects is within sixty days before the end of a grant
performance period and the City will be 100% reimbursed by SHSGP or UASI.” The
performance period end date for the 2020 State Homeland Security Grant Program is
May 31, 2023. Staff seeks permission to allocate $64,360 from Fiscal Year 2022-23
Budget funds for the project.

BACKGROUND:
On March 23, 2023, the Fire Department was notified of an approved modification for an
increase of $64,360 for the SHSP 2020 Grant. The cost savings funds are to be spent
and reimbursement claims submitted to the County of Los Angeles per the grant
agreement. The cost savings funds will supplement the remainder of the contract with
CounterRisk, Inc.

 Respectfully submitted by:  Prepared by:

  Matthew Hallock  Angela Loera
  Fire Chief  Principal Management Analyst

 Approved by:  Reviewed by:

  Ron Bow  Karl H. Berger
  City Manager  City Attorney
